combo_label: In the Bathroom × At the Art Gallery × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Trusting poke-bonneted duck who accepted a dinner invitation from a fox
Gruff Scots-named grower who tried to trap a trespassing rabbit under a sieve
Minty swig you slosh about but never swallow
Sugar magnate's surname over Britain's modern collection
Slippery bar that leaps from wet hands like a fish
Disobedient rabbit in blue who gorged on radishes and dodged a rake
Whiskered attic ruffian who rolled a kitten in dough for a roly-poly pudding
Thumb-holed board where a painter mixes colours
The quality that sets crimson apart from scarlet
Morning armpit armour, rolled or sprayed on
Terry rectangle promoted to cape, turban or kilt as needed
Painting done straight onto a whole wall
